data.notes: January 2027 in Rio is anchored by New Year’s spillover, major stadium rock, electronic sunset parties, and the first confirmed wave of pre-Carnival samba programming.

events.title: System of a Down + Faith No More
events.summary: System of a Down and Faith No More play a large-scale Rio stadium date at Maracanã, with gates listed for 16:00.

events.title: Rush: Fifty Something Tour
events.summary: Rush’s official tour page confirms a Rio de Janeiro date at Estádio Olímpico Nilton Santos on January 30, 2027, with Eventim listing gates at 16:00.

events.title: CasaBloco: Noite dos Tambores
events.summary: Noite dos Tambores brings Tambores de Olokun, Imperatriz Leopoldinense with Maracatu Nação Porto Rico, Cortejo Afro with Larissa Luz, BaianaSystem, Buchecha’s Baile Só Love and DJs to CasaBloco.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2027 Technical Rehearsals and Lavagem da Sapucaí — Viradouro, Grande Rio and Mangueira
events.summary: The final January rehearsal date includes the traditional Lavagem da Sapucaí from 17:00, followed from 19:00 by Unidos do Viradouro, Acadêmicos do Grande Rio and Estação Primeira de Mangueira.

events.title: CasaBloco: É Festa do Norte ao Nordeste
events.summary: CasaBloco’s second 2027 night highlights music from Brazil’s North and Northeast, with Sinfônica Ambulante, Fafá de Belém, Alceu Valença, Sidney Magal’s Baile Cigano, DJ JP and DJ Pepe Jordão.

events.title: CasaBloco: Samba Pra Ti
events.summary: CasaBloco’s opening 2027 night celebrates samba with Moacyr Luz & Samba do Trabalhador, Diogo Nogueira with Marina Iris, Baile do Cacique de Ramos, DJ JP and DJ Cris Panttoja.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2027 Technical Rehearsals — União de Maricá, Beija-Flor and Paraíso do Tuiuti
events.summary: Riotur’s confirmed pre-Carnival programme lists children’s samba schools from 17:30, followed from 20:00 by União de Maricá, Beija-Flor de Nilópolis and Paraíso do Tuiuti at Sapucaí.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2027 Technical Rehearsals — Vila Isabel, Mocidade and Unidos da Tijuca
events.summary: The January 24 technical-rehearsal night lists children’s schools from 17:00, followed from 19:00 by Unidos de Vila Isabel, Mocidade Independente de Padre Miguel and Unidos da Tijuca.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2027 Technical Rehearsals — Salgueiro, Imperatriz and Portela
events.summary: Riotur confirms January 30 at Sapucaí with children’s samba schools from 17:30 and the main rehearsals by Acadêmicos do Salgueiro, Imperatriz Leopoldinense and Portela from 20:00.

events.title: Rio Réveillon 2027
events.summary: The confirmed Jockey Club New Year’s programme runs from 21:00 on December 31 to 05:00 on January 1, with Bom Gosto, Fica Comigo, samba-school drums and DJs.

events.title: S.O.S Rio — Sound of Sunset: Mochakk Special Set
events.summary: Sound of Sunset brings Mochakk for a special set at Praça Mauá, with ANNA, Analu, JORD and Fancy Inc also listed for the first Sunday sunset of 2027.

events.title: Woof Week Rio 2027
events.summary: Week-long LGBTQ+ bear-week festival with nighttime parties, pool parties, boat events, tours, and shows across Rio.

events.title: TMX Sessions @ Xian Rooftop - TOMMAX B'day
events.summary: Afro-house/house rooftop session from TOMMAX’s TMX Sessions brand at Xian Rio, positioned as a daytime-to-sunset birthday edition.

events.title: Barko - Primeiro Mergulho
events.summary: House-led summer day party at Marina da Glória from Kbral, framed as Barko’s first “mergulho” of the year.

events.title: Hole: Primeira Do Anvs 2027
events.summary: Queer Rio party HOLE opens 2027 with a late-night edition in Saúde, listing DJs Rafa Guerra and JP aka JP plus performances and an interactive live show.
